name: Echo
description: A spirit bound to an object; Echoes counter the fungus by turning themselves into a sickness.

timeline.summary: Echoes destroy mycoids by entering them as a counter-infection.
timeline.quote: It dissolved into blue smoke as if consumed by invisible fire.

pages_say.description: A spirit bound to an object, as Abuelo is bound to his poncho.
